lines.title: The GitHub Copilot app can use your own model provider too. Here's how to put Semantic Router dot net behind it.
lines.add: Open settings, then model providers, and add an OpenAI compatible provider. Use the router's address, and any key. The router holds the real credentials.
lines.pick: Then choose semantic router in the session's model picker.
lines.context: The app wraps every message in context: your workspace, the time, a few reminders. The router sets that aside, and routes on what you actually typed.
lines.turns: So a quick question stays on a local model, and a hard one goes to a frontier model.
lines.end: That's Semantic Router dot net with the Copilot app. Open source, MIT licensed, and one command to install.
